meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按技能指南排查容器化代理系统的问题:查看各日志文件、检查两个会话数据库中的消息流动、核对挂载点,并依据常见问题清单给出解决步骤。
howto.when: 当你遇到系统不工作、容器故障、认证问题等状况,或想了解容器系统如何运作时触发。

say.text: 帮我查看 nanoclaw.error.log,看看容器为什么没回复。
say.note: Claude 会读取日志并定位错误。

say.text: 检查 inbound.db 和 outbound.db,看消息到了没。
say.note: Claude 会查询两个数据库的消息记录。

say.text: 容器启动后马上退出,帮我排查原因。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows this guide to debug the container agent: checks logs, inspects the two session DBs for message flow, checks mounts, and applies the common-issue fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when things aren't working, a container fails, there are authentication problems, or when you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: Check nanoclaw.error.log and tell me why the container didn't reply.
say_en.note: Claude reads the log and pinpoints the error.

say_en.text: Check inbound.db and outbound.db to see if the message arrived or got a reply.
say_en.note: Claude queries both databases for message flow.

say_en.text: The container exits right after starting; help me debug it.
say_en.note: Claude checks logs for Container exited and stderr.
